author: Marcus, 1955

note.en: A small slug that lives on turtle grass blades, known here from three museum specimens at Cahuita and Manzanillo.
note.es: Una pequeña babosa que vive sobre hojas de pasto de tortuga, conocida aquí por tres ejemplares de museo de Cahuita y Manzanillo.

evidence: GBIF: 3 museum specimens, Cahuita and Manzanillo (1998, 1999)

sources.t: GBIF: preserved specimens, Universidad de Costa Rica collection (Calderón, Avila and others, 1998 to 2003)
WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and classification
